artworks.title: Lake Kivu, Congo (1946)
artworks.description: Irma Stern, Lake Kivu, Congo (1946), oil on canvas, 56 x 56 cm  Introduction   Landscape art is often a record of a response to familiar places, places that the artist knows well. But for Irma Stern, landscape (as well as much portraiture) was a record of response to exotic places and involved extensive travel. Far from her home in Cape Town, she found both excitement and solace in the landscapes of distant southern African sites (Senegal, Zanzibar, the Congo, areas within northern South Africa)
